verses.geez: መኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘጥትቃወመኒ።
verses.translation: Hast thou not seen him? and hast thou not wondered at the things said of him?

translations.lxx: Hast thou not seen him? and hast thou not wondered at the things said of him?
translations.kjv: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?
translations.ron: Poţi tu să prinzi leviatanul cu undiţa, ori să-i legi limba cu o sfoară?

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ውእቱ፡ ዘይትዋሥአኒ፡ ወየሐዩ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘታሕተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ዚአየ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: Dost thou not fear because preparation has been made by me? for who is there that resists me?

translations.lxx: Dost thou not fear because preparation has been made by me? for who is there that resists me?
translations.kjv: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
translations.ron: Vei putea tu să-i vâri în nas o trestie sau să-i găureşti falca cu cârligul?

verses.geez: ወኢያረምም፡ በእንቲአሁ፡ ወቃለ፡ ኃይል፡ ይሣሃሎ፡ ለዘከማሁ።
verses.translation: Or who will resist me, and abide, since the whole world under heaven is mine?

translations.lxx: Or who will resist me, and abide, since the whole world under heaven is mine?
translations.kjv: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft words unto thee?
translations.ron: Îţi va face el multe rugăminţi şi îţi va spune el lucruri drăgălaşe?

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ዘይቀፍጽ፡ ግልባቤ፡ ገጹ፡ ወመኑ፡ ይበእው፡ ውስተ፡ ማኅበርተ፡ እብግድዓሁ።
verses.translation: I will not be silent because of him: though because of his power one shall pity his antagonist.

translations.lxx: I will not be silent because of him: though because of his power one shall pity his antagonist.
translations.kjv: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
translations.ron: Ori va face cu tine legământ şi-l vei lua la tine rob pe toată viaţa?

verses.geez: ወመኑ፡ ያርኁ፡ መዓፁተ፡ ዘቅድመ፡ ገጹ፡ ወዖዶ፡ ለሥነኒሁ፡ ግርማ።
verses.translation: Who will open the face of his garment? and who can enter within the fold of his breast-plate?

translations.lxx: Who will open the face of his garment? and who can enter within the fold of his breast-plate?
translations.kjv: Wilt thou play with him as with a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
translations.ron: Te vei juca tu cu el, cum te joci cu o pasăre, sau îl vei lega tu ca să-ţi înveseleşti fetele?

verses.geez: ወአማዑቲሂኒ፡ አራዊት፡ ዘብርት፡ ወቊጽረቱኒ፡ ከመ፡ እብነ፡ ኰኵሕ።
verses.translation: Who will open the doors of his face? terror is round about his teeth.

translations.lxx: Who will open the doors of his face? terror is round about his teeth.
translations.kjv: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
translations.ron: Pescarii întovărăşiţi vor putea să-l scoată de vânzare şi negustorii să-l vândă cu bucata?

verses.geez: ወአሐዱ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ ተጣበቀ፡ ወመንፈስሂ፡ ኢይበርሮ።
verses.translation: His inwards are as brazen plates, and the texture of his skin as a smyrite stone.

translations.lxx: His inwards are as brazen plates, and the texture of his skin as a smyrite stone.
translations.kjv: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
translations.ron: Vei putea tu să-i găureşti pielea cu săgeţi şi capul cu cârligul pescăresc?

verses.geez: ወያስተላክዕ፡ ብእሴ፡ ምስለ፡ እኁሁ፡ ይጣበቁ፡ ወኢይትፋትሑ።
verses.translation: One part cleaves fast to another, and the air cannot come between them.

translations.lxx: One part cleaves fast to another, and the air cannot come between them.
translations.kjv: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
translations.ron: Ridică-ţi numai mâna împotriva lui şi vei pomeni de o asemenea luptă şi nu o vei mai începe niciodată!

verses.geez: ወበዕጠሱ፡ ይበርቅ፡ ብርሃነ፡ ወአዕይንቲሁ፡ ከመ፡ ኮከበ፡ ጽባሕ።
verses.translation: They will remain united each to the other: they are closely joined, and cannot be separated.

translations.lxx: They will remain united each to the other: they are closely joined, and cannot be separated.
translations.kjv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
translations.ron: Iată, este o deşertăciune să mai nădăjduieşti în izbândă; numai înfăţişarea lui şi te dă la pământ.

verses.geez: ወእምአፉሁ፡ ይወጽአ፡ መኃትው፡ ዘይነድድ፡ ወይዌሩ፡ አፍሐመ።
verses.translation: At his sneezing a light shines, and his eyes are as the appearance of the morning star.

translations.lxx: At his sneezing a light shines, and his eyes are as the appearance of the morning star.
translations.kjv: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
translations.ron: Cine este atât de nechibzuit încât să-l întărâte? Cine va îndrăzni să dea piept cu Mine?

verses.geez: ወእምአንፉ፡ ይወጽእ፡ ጢስ፡ ከመ፡ እቶን፡ ዘይነድድ፡ በአፍሐመ፡ እሳት።
verses.translation: Out of his mouth proceed as it were burning lamps, and as it were hearths of fire are cast abroad.

translations.lxx: Out of his mouth proceed as it were burning lamps, and as it were hearths of fire are cast abroad.
translations.kjv: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
translations.ron: Cine M-a îndatorat cu ceva, ca să fiu acum dator să-i dau înapoi? Tot ce se află sub ceruri este al Meu.

verses.geez: ነፍሱሂ፡ ፍሕም፡ ይእቲ፡ ወነበልባል፡ ይወጽእ፡ እምአፉሁ፡፡ 13፡ ወውስተ፡ ክሳዱ፡ ኃደረ፡ ኃይል፡ ወወዓለ፡ ሞት፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለዘይሬእዮ።
verses.translation: Out of his nostrils proceeds smoke of a furnace burning with fire of coals.

translations.lxx: Out of his nostrils proceeds smoke of a furnace burning with fire of coals.
translations.kjv: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
translations.ron: Cât despre leviatan, voi vorbi despre mădularele lui şi despre tăria lui şi despre frumoasa lui întocmire.

verses.geez: ሥጋ፡ ነፍስቱ፡ ጥቡቅ፡ ወእመሂ፡ ሦጡ፡ እብነ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ኢይትሐወስ።
verses.translation: And power is lodged in his neck, before him destruction runs.

translations.lxx: And power is lodged in his neck, before him destruction runs.
translations.kjv: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
translations.ron: Cine a deschis vreodată porţile gurii lui? Zimţii lui sunt îngrozitori!

verses.geez: ወልቡሂ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ እብነ፡ ጾላዕ፡ ወይቀውም፡ ከመ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ንኡስ።
verses.translation: The flesh also of his body is joined together: if one pours violence upon him, he shall not be moved.

translations.lxx: The flesh also of his body is joined together: if one pours violence upon him, he shall not be moved.
translations.kjv: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
translations.ron: Spinarea lui este ca un şirag de scuturi, pe care le-ai fi întărit şi pecetluit puternic.

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ ተመይጠ፡ ይሜምዑ፡ ኵሊ፡ አራዊተ፡ ገዳም፡ ወእንስሳ፡ ወዘይትሐወስ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: His heart is firm as a stone, and it stands like an unyielding anvil.

translations.lxx: His heart is firm as a stone, and it stands like an unyielding anvil.
translations.kjv: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
translations.ron: Ele sunt strânse unul într-altul atât de tare, că nici vântul nu pătrunde printre ele.

verses.geez: ወእመሂ፡ ጠበቆ፡ ኵያንው፡ አልቦ፡ ዘይሬስዮ።
verses.translation: And when he turns, he is a terror to the four-footed wild beasts which leap upon the earth.

translations.lxx: And when he turns, he is a terror to the four-footed wild beasts which leap upon the earth.
translations.kjv: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
translations.ron: Fiecare e lipit de cel de lângă el şi se ţin aşa şi nu se mai despart.

verses.geez: ረምሕ፡ ወልብሰ፡ ሐፂም፡ ከመ፡ ኃሠር፡ እሙንቱ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ወብርትኒ፡ ከመ፡ ዕፅ፡ ብኍቡኍ።
verses.translation: If spears should come against him, men will effect nothing, either with the spear or the breast-plate.

translations.lxx: If spears should come against him, men will effect nothing, either with the spear or the breast-plate.
translations.kjv: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
translations.ron: Din strănutul lui scapără lumină şi ochii lui sunt roşii ca pleoapele zorilor.

verses.geez: ወኢይሰቊሮ፡ ቀስተ፡ ብርት፡ ወእብንኒ፡ ከመ፡ ኃሠር፡ ወይመስሎ፡ ብርዐ፡ መፍጽሕ፡ ወይሰብክ፡ ላዕለ፡ እብን፡ ዓቢይ።
verses.translation: For he considers iron as chaff, and brass as rotten wood.

translations.lxx: For he considers iron as chaff, and brass as rotten wood.
translations.kjv: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
translations.ron: Din gura lui ies parcă nişte torţe aprinse şi izbucnesc valuri de scântei.

verses.geez: ወምስካቡሂ፡ ሐውልት፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ወርቀ፡ ባሕር፡ በኀቤሁ፡ ከመ፡ ጽቡር፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ኍልቊ።
verses.translation: The bow of brass shall not wound him, he deems a slinger as grass.

translations.lxx: The bow of brass shall not wound him, he deems a slinger as grass.
translations.kjv: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
translations.ron: Din nările lui iese fum, ca dintr-o căldare pusă la foc şi care fierbe.

verses.geez: ወያንሰአስኣ፡ ለሲኦል፡ ከመ፡ ጽሕርት፡ ወባሕርኒ፡ በድወ፡ ይመስሎ።
verses.translation: Mauls are counted as stubble; and he laughs to scorn the waving of the firebrand.

translations.lxx: Mauls are counted as stubble; and he laughs to scorn the waving of the firebrand.
translations.kjv: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
translations.ron: Răsuflarea lui este de cărbuni aprinşi şi din gura lui ţâşnesc flăcări.

verses.geez: ወቊረ፡ ሲኦልኒ፡ ከመ፡ ፄው፡ ወረሰያ፡ ለሲኦል፡ ከመ፡ ኀበ፡ ያንሶሱ።
verses.translation: His lair is formed of sharp points; and all the gold of the sea under him is as an immense quantity of clay.

translations.lxx: His lair is formed of sharp points; and all the gold of the sea under him is as an immense quantity of clay.
translations.kjv: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
translations.ron: Puterea lui e adunată în grumazul lui şi înaintea lui ţâşneşte groaza.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ በዲበ፡ ምድር፡ ወኢምንትኒ፡ ዘከማሁ፡ ወተፈጢሮ፡ ሰሐቁ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ መላእክቲሁ።
verses.translation: He makes the deep boil like a brazen caldron; and he regards the sea as a pot of ointment,

translations.lxx: He makes the deep boil like a brazen caldron; and he regards the sea as a pot of ointment,
translations.kjv: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
translations.ron: Carnea lui e îndesată; oricât ai apăsa în ea nu se lasă.

verses.geez: ወይሬኢ፡ ኵሎ፡ ነዋኀ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ምጉሦሙ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ሰማይ።
verses.translation: and the lowest part of the deep as a captive: he reckons the deep as his range.

translations.lxx: and the lowest part of the deep as a captive: he reckons the deep as his range.
translations.kjv: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
translations.ron: Inima lui este tare ca piatra, tare ca piatra râşniţei, cea de dedesubt.
